description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class 'PocketApiResource' for managing 'pockets' within a self-service context. It includes endpoints for linking/delinking accounts to/from pockets and retrieving linked accounts, utilizing JAX-RS annotations, Swagger annotations for documentation, and services for command processing and data retrieval.

classes.name: PocketApiResource
classes.description: A REST API controller class handling 'pockets' related endpoints for linking/delinking accounts and retrieving linked accounts in a self-service context.

methods.name: handleCommands
methods.description: Handles POST requests to link or delink accounts to/from pockets based on command parameters; processes command, invokes service, throws exception on unrecognized command, and serializes response.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all accounts linked to pockets by querying the relevant service and returning serialized JSON.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Helper method to check if a command parameter matches a specific command value, case-insensitive.
